_doc: Tier -> model per vendor. verified=true: checked on the vendor's own model page on the date in 'verified'; 'partial': vendor release notes + secondary sources; re-check sources[] before relying on it. Edit freely; verify.py checks the shape.

L.use: lookups, renames, formatting, status, small edits, search/scan

M.use: features, bug fixes, docs, design drafts, video edits

H.use: architecture, hard debugging, research synthesis, security, multi-file refactors

X.use: long autonomous builds, deep research, novel algorithms (add sub-agents)

claude.switch: Claude Code: /model (and the effort setting where offered); sub-agents scout=haiku, builder=sonnet, reviewer=opus. claude.ai: model picker.

gemini.switch: Gemini CLI: /model or --model; Antigravity: model selector.

openai.switch: Codex CLI: /model and reasoning effort setting; ChatGPT: model picker.
openai.note: IDs from OpenAI's model page slugs; confirm in the API reference

grok.L: grok-build-0.1 (fast coding) or grok-4.7 at low reasoning
grok.X: grok-4.7 (Grok Build for long agentic runs)

kimi.X: kimi-k3 in Kimi Code / agent mode

domain_hints.video/image/audio generation: the LLM tier only plans and scripts; quality comes from the engine in studio/SYSTEM.md, so M is usually enough
domain_hints.UI/visual design: H for a new design system or brand, M for screens in an existing system
domain_hints.research: H, and use recon/RECON.md; X only for multi-day surveys
domain_hints.code review / security: H, and run it in a separate session or the reviewer agent (independent check)
